summary: POET Technologies filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing a press release dated November 2, 2026, announcing the appointment of Giovanni M. Pacelli as CFO effective November 2, 2026, succeeding Thomas Mika after ten years in the role. No price, stake, premium, or transaction terms are stated. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Pacelli joins from Silicon Labs with three decades of semiconductor finance experience; Mika remains through December 2, 2026 to support transition, and POET will begin quarterly earnings calls with fourth-quarter 2026 results. Watch execution continuity and investor-engagement ramp rather than deal mechanics.
